error_string_origin: frontend API-client timeout conversion (requests ReadTimeout -> ErrorCategory.REQUEST_TIMEOUT -> locale error_request_timeout + error_operation_suffix). Not a server error, not a reverse-proxy timeout, not a provider-side exception surfaced directly.

flow.detail: st.button(t('student_revision_submit'), type='primary', use_container_width=True, key='revision_submit_primary') in app/ui/features/student/revision.py (render_revision_page). No disabled/locked state; no session-state pending guard.

On click: builds submission dict with revision_of_submission_id=source_id (selected via revision_source_select), calls loading_box('student_revision_submitting'), then api_client.submit(submission). On ApiClientError -> render_api_error(exc, lang); on generic Exception -> error_box('submission_error', lang).

WritingFeedbackApiClient.submit(submission) -> self._request('POST', '/api/v1/submissions', operation='submit', json=submission). No profile argument -> DEFAULT_TIMEOUTS. No retry (retry defaults False; automatic retry only ever allowed for GET).

_request computes timeout_tuple = (profile.connect, profile.read) for GET else (profile.connect, profile.write); POST -> (2.0, 30.0). requests.Session.request(timeout=(2.0, 30.0)). Connect timeout 2.0 s; response (write/read) timeout 30.0 s for the linked-revision POST.

requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout or ConnectTimeout -> classify_exception -> ApiClientError(ErrorCategory.REQUEST_TIMEOUT, 'read timed out'/'connect timed out', operation='submit'); retryable=True. render_api_error shows locale error_request_timeout ('The request took too long and was stopped. Please try again.') + error_operation_suffix ('(while {operation})' -> '(while submit)') and, because retryable, a Retry button (st.rerun()).

SubmissionService.submit: (1) validate_relationship when revision_of_submission_id is set; (2) save_essay (durable essay row; revision fields); (3) analyzer.analyze (spaCy, ~25-61 ms); (4) save_analysis_run + save_analysis; (5) diagnose; (6) calibrate + save_diagnostic_calibration; (7) revision_service.create_relationship (revision group / link / snapshot - durable); (8) history.summarize; (9) learner_profile recalc; (10) reliability assessment; (11) router.generate(context) - the slow provider/LLM call (incident: deepseek 30.4-37.7 s then local-demo fallback); (12) revision group_summary + trajectory; (13) save_feedback + save_history; (14) return PipelineResult -> response.

Essay, analysis, diagnosis, calibration, revision relationship, history, and learner profile are durably saved BEFORE router.generate; feedback and history are saved after it. The response is created only after the provider call completes. A client disconnect does not cancel the FastAPI sync endpoint thread; the backend continues and commits.

GET /api/v1/students/{student_id}/revision-candidates (returns reversed list_student_submissions: essay_id, revision_of_submission_id, revision_group_id, revision_sequence, submitted_at (server ISO UTC), stage fields; newest first; GET with retry=True). GET /api/v1/submissions/{submission_id} (full bundle incl. essay_text, metrics, diagnosis, feedback_id, success_status, provider_name).
